backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with authorization mixin, all core data types (members, finances, programs, groups, attendance), and initializes storage maps for each entity.
feature_evidence.json: Contains evidence metadata for a feature detecting 3 consecutive absences, listing affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and their roles in routing, data fetching, UI layout, and feature logic.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS layers and OKLCH-based color variables for light and dark themes with shared global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up authentication, section gating, theming, routing, and layout for the React application.
Component for viewing and updating section committee roles using dialogs and member selection.
frontend/src/components/financial/Financ: Displays a dialog showing detailed financial report entries, grouping deposits and expenses and formatting values for display.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupFina: Manages listing, creating, editing, and deleting group financial reports through a dialog with form handling and API mutations.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main app layout with header, navigation, mobile menu, logout handling, and section-based UI context.
frontend/src/components/SyncStatus.tsx: Displays backend sync status with a spinner and last sync time using React Query indicators.
frontend/src/contexts/SectionContext.tsx: Stores and manages the current user section, loads it from profile, saves updates, and exposes helper utilities via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity authentication, storing identities, managing login/logout state, and exposing the auth context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, members, financial reports, groups, attendance, and related data using the actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes using a warm neutral palette with green accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and mounts the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Displays and manages attendance records, including creating, editing, deleting, and checking for consecutive absences.
Manages financial reports with forms for income, vows, expenses, and includes dialogs for editing and viewing details.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Allows listing, creating, editing, and deleting groups, assigning leadership roles, and viewing group financial reports.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders a login screen using Internet Identity with a branded card UI.
frontend/src/pages/MembersPage.tsx: UI page for listing, searching, creating, editing, and deleting members within the current section using dialogs and form state.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Page to list, sort, create, edit, and delete programs for a section, with member lookup for role assignments.
frontend/src/pages/SectionSelectPage.tsx: User onboarding page allowing name entry and section selection, saving the profile via API.
frontend/src/utils/attendanceConsecutive: Utility to detect members with three or more consecutive absences from attendance records.
frontend/src/utils/memberAge.ts: Functions to calculate and format age from a date-of-birth string with validation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using URLSearchParams and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks project schema version, app requirements for multi-tenant church management features, architectural notes, and known issues. Lists implemented features such as section selection, member CRUD, and financial reporting.
